# We're in the beginning of implementing Driftboard, (2025-07-09 18:05Z)

_**User (2025-07-09 18:26Z)**_

We're in the beginning of implementing Driftboard, a kanban board application. Looks like we're more than halfway through Phase 1 (based on the phases in `07-implementation-phase`). `01.mvp-completion-summary` covers much of what has been completed, while `04.phase-assessment-next-steps` correlates this to the main plan, and lays out our actual next steps.

With that context, let's proceed to complete Phase 1! 

We can hold off on Firebase Auth until other features in Phase 1 are complete. The project is primarily designed for me to use locally, and public deployment + multi-user access is down the road. That said, I don't want to leave it until the end, but I think API and drag-n-drop are more important right now.

I would prefer to implement list and cards management API endpoints first, and then develop automated and manual tests (via `curl` or otherwise) of those endpoints prior to implementing #4, Drag & Drop.

If we need a more detailed plan to complete Phase 1, let's make it. Otherwise, let's proceed.

=&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n\n    if (!id) {\n      res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: 'List ID is required',\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const list = await prisma.list.findUnique({\n      where: { id },\n      include: {\n        cards: {\n          orderBy: { position: 'asc' },\n          include: {\n            labels: true,\n          },\n        },\n      },\n    });\n\n    if (!list) {\n      res.status(404).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: 'List not found',\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const response: ApiResponse&lt;List&gt; = {\n      success: true,\n      data: list,\n    };\n\n    res.json(response);\n  } catch (error) {\n    next(error);\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * PUT /api/lists/:id\n * Update a list (name, position)\n */\nrouter.put('/:id', async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise&lt;void&gt; =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    const updateData: UpdateListDto = req.body;\n\n    if (!id) {\n      res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: 'List ID is required',\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Validate input\n    if (updateData.name !== undefined &amp;&amp; (!updateData.name || updateData.name.trim().length === 0)) {\n      res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: 'List name cannot be empty',\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Check if list exists\n    const existingList = await prisma.list.findUnique({\n      where: { id },\n    });\n\n    if (!existingList) {\n      res.status(404).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: 'List not found',\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // If position is being updated, handle reordering\n    if (updateData.position !== undefined &amp;&amp; updateData.position !== existingList.position) {\n      // Calculate new positions for reordering\n      const oldPosition = existingList.position;\n      const newPosition = updateData.position;\n\n      // Update positions of other lists\n      if (newPosition &lt; oldPosition) {\n        // Moving up - shift lists down\n        await prisma.list.updateMany({\n          where: {\n            boardId: existingList.boardId,\n            position: {\n              gte: newPosition,\n              lt: oldPosition,\n            },\n          },\n          data: {\n            position: {\n              increment: 1,\n            },\n          },\n        });\n      } else {\n        // Moving down - shift lists up\n        await prisma.list.updateMany({\n          where: {\n            boardId: existingList.boardId,\n            position: {\n              gt: oldPosition,\n              lte: newPosition,\n            },\n          },\n          data: {\n            position: {\n              decrement: 1,\n            },\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Update the list\n    const updatedList = await prisma.list.update({\n      where: { id },\n      data: {\n        ...(updateData.name &amp;&amp;   "textEditContent": "#!/bin/bash\n\n# DriftBoard API Manual Testing Scripts\n# Lists CRUD Operations\n#\n# Prerequisites:\n# 1. Backend server running on http://localhost:8000\n# 2. Database seeded with test data\n# 3. jq installed for JSON formatting (optional)\n#\n# Usage:\n#   chmod +x lists-crud.sh\n#   ./lists-crud.sh\n\nBASE_URL=\"http://localhost:8000/api\"\nBOARD_ID=\"\"  # Will be fetched from boards API\nLIST_ID=\"\"   # Will be captured from create response\n\necho \"=== DriftBoard Lists API Testing ===\"\necho \"\"\n\n# Helper function for formatted output\npretty_print() {\n    if command -v jq &amp;&gt; /dev/null; then\n        echo \"$1\" | jq '.'\n    else\n        echo \"$1\"\n    fi\n}\n\necho \"🔍 1. Get existing boards to find a board ID...\"\nBOARDS_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X GET \\\n    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n    \"$BASE_URL/boards\")\n\necho \"Boards Response:\"\npretty_print \"$BOARDS_RESPONSE\"\n\n# Extract first board ID (assumes jq is available)\nif command -v jq &amp;&gt; /dev/null; then\n    BOARD_ID=$(echo \"$BOARDS_RESPONSE\" | jq -r '.data[0].id // empty')\n    if [ -z \"$BOARD_ID\" ]; then\n        echo \"❌ No boards found. Please create a board first or check if the server is running.\"\n        exit 1\n    fi\n    echo \"✅ Using Board ID: $BOARD_ID\"\nelse\n    echo \"⚠️  jq not found. Please manually extract a board ID and set BOARD_ID variable.\"\n    echo \"   Install jq with: brew install jq (macOS) or apt-get install jq (Ubuntu)\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\necho \"\"\necho \"📋 2. Create a new list...\"\nCREATE_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST \\\n    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n    -d '{\n        \"name\": \"Test List Created by Script\",\n        \"position\": 0\n    }' \\\n    \"$BASE_URL/boards/$BOARD_ID/lists\")\n\necho \"Create List Response:\"\npretty_print \"$CREATE_RESPONSE\"\n\n# Extract list ID from response\nLIST_ID=$(echo \"$CREATE_RESPONSE\" | jq -r '.data.id // empty')\nif [ -z \"$LIST_ID\" ]; then\n    echo \"❌ Failed to create list or extract list ID\"\n    exit 1\nfi\necho \"✅ Created List ID: $LIST_ID\"\n\necho \"\"\necho \"📖 3. Get the specific list...\"\nGET_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X GET \\\n    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n    \"$BASE_URL/lists/$LIST_ID\")\n\necho \"Get List Response:\"\npretty_print \"$GET_RESPONSE\"\n\necho \"\"\necho \"✏️  4. Update the list name...\"\nUPDATE_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X PUT \\\n    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n    -d '{\n        \"name\": \"Updated Test List - Modified by Script\"\n    }' \\\n    \"$BASE_URL/lists/$LIST_ID\")\n\necho \"Update List Response:\"\npretty_print \"$UPDATE_RESPONSE\"\n\necho \"\"\necho \"📊 5. Get board to see the updated list...\"\nBOARD_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X GET \\\n    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n    \"$BASE_URL/boards/$BOARD_ID\")\n\necho \"Board with Lists Response:\"\npretty_print \"$BOARD_RESPONSE\"\n\necho \"\"\necho \"🗑️  6. Delete the test list...\"\nDELETE_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X DELETE \\\n    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n    \"$BASE_URL/lists/$LIST_ID\")\n\necho \"Delete List Response:\"\npretty_print \"$DELETE_RESPONSE\"\n\necho \"\"\necho \"✅ 7.   "textEditContent": "#!/bin/bash\n\n# DriftBoard API Manual Testing Scripts\n# Move Operations (Cards between Lists, List reordering)\n#\n# Prerequisites:\n# 1. Backend server running on http://localhost:8000\n# 2. Database seeded with test data (multiple lists and cards)\n# 3. jq installed for JSON formatting\n#\n# Usage:\n#   chmod +x move-operations.sh\n#   ./move-operations.sh\n\nBASE_URL=\"http://localhost:8000/api\"\n\necho \"=== DriftBoard Move Operations Testing ===\"\necho \"\"\n\n# Helper function for formatted output\npretty_print() {\n    if command -v jq &amp;&gt; /dev/null; then\n        echo \"$1\" | jq '.'\n    else\n        echo \"$1\"\n    fi\n}\n\necho \"🔍 1. Get boards to find test data...\"\nBOARDS_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X GET \\\n    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n    \"$BASE_URL/boards\")\n\nif ! command -v jq &amp;&gt; /dev/null; then\n    echo \"❌ jq is required for this test script\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\nBOARD_ID=$(echo \"$BOARDS_RESPONSE\" | jq -r '.data[0].id // empty')\nif [ -z \"$BOARD_ID\" ]; then\n    echo \"❌ No boards found\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\necho \"✅ Using Board ID: $BOARD_ID\"\n\n# Check if we have at least 2 lists\nLIST_COUNT=$(echo \"$BOARDS_RESPONSE\" | jq -r '.data[0].lists | length')\nif [ \"$LIST_COUNT\" -lt 2 ]; then\n    echo \"⚠️  Need at least 2 lists for move testing. Creating additional lists...\"\n    \n    # Create a second list\n    curl -s -X POST \\\n        -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n        -d '{\"name\": \"Second List for Testing\", \"position\": 1}' \\\n        \"$BASE_URL/boards/$BOARD_ID/lists\" &gt; /dev/null\n    \n    # Refresh board data\n    BOARDS_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X GET \\\n        -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n        \"$BASE_URL/boards\")\nfi\n\n# Extract list IDs\nLIST1_ID=$(echo \"$BOARDS_RESPONSE\" | jq -r '.data[0].lists[0].id')\nLIST2_ID=$(echo \"$BOARDS_RESPONSE\" | jq -r '.data[0].lists[1].id')\n\necho \"✅ List 1 ID: $LIST1_ID\"\necho \"✅ List 2 ID: $LIST2_ID\"\n\necho \"\"\necho \"📄 2. Create test cards in first list...\"\nCARD1_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST \\\n    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n    -d '{\"title\": \"Card 1 - Move Test\", \"position\": 0}' \\\n    \"$BASE_URL/lists/$LIST1_ID/cards\")\n\nCARD2_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST \\\n    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n    -d '{\"title\": \"Card 2 - Move Test\", \"position\": 1}' \\\n    \"$BASE_URL/lists/$LIST1_ID/cards\")\n\nCARD1_ID=$(echo \"$CARD1_RESPONSE\" | jq -r '.data.id')\nCARD2_ID=$(echo \"$CARD2_RESPONSE\" | jq -r '.data.id')\n\necho \"✅ Created Card 1 ID: $CARD1_ID\"\necho \"✅ Created Card 2 ID: $CARD2_ID\"\n\necho \"\"\necho \"📊 3. Show initial state...\"\nINITIAL_STATE=$(curl -s -X GET \"$BASE_URL/boards/$BOARD_ID\")\necho \"Initial Board State:\"\necho \"$INITIAL_STATE\" | jq '.data.lists[] | {id: .id, name: .name, cards: [.cards[] | {id: .id, title: .title, position: .position}]}'\n\necho \"\"\necho \"🔄 4. Move Card 1 to List 2...\"\nMOVE_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X PUT \\\n    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n    -d '{\n        \"listId\": \"'$LIST2_ID'\",\n        \"position\": 0\n    }' \\\n    \"$BASE_URL/cards/$CARD1_ID/move\")\n\necho \"Move Card Response:\"\npretty_print \"$MOVE_RESPONSE\"\n\necho \"\"\necho \"📊 5. Show state after move...\"\nAFTER_MOVE_STATE=$(curl -s -X GET \"$BASE_URL/boards/$BOARD_ID\")\necho \"Board State After Move:\"\necho \"$AFTER_MOVE_STATE\" | jq '.data.lists[] | {id: .id, name: .name, cards: [.cards[] | {id: .id, title: .title, position: .position}]}'\n\necho \"\"\necho \"🔄 6. Test reordering cards within a list...\"\n# Move Card 2 to position 0 (should push other cards down)\nREORDER_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X PUT \\\n    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n    -d '{\"position\": 0}' \\\n    \"$BASE_URL/cards/$CARD2_ID\")\n\necho \"Reorder Card Response:\"\npretty_print \"$REORDER_RESPONSE\"\n\necho \"\"\necho \"📊 7. Show final state...\"\nFINAL_STATE=$(curl -s -X GET \"$BASE_URL/boards/$BOARD_ID\")\necho \"Final Board State:\"\necho \"$FINAL_STATE\" | jq '.data.lists[] | {id: .id, name: .name, cards: [.cards[] | {id: .id, title: .title, position: .position}]}'\n\necho \"\"\necho \"🧹 8. Cleanup test cards...\"\ncurl -s -X DELETE \"$BASE_URL/cards/$CARD1_ID\" &gt; /dev/null\ncurl -s -X DELETE \"$BASE_URL/cards/$CARD2_ID\" &gt; /dev/null\necho \"✅ Test cards deleted\"\n\necho \"\"\necho \"🎉 Move operations testing complete!\"\necho \"\"\necho \"Summary of operations tested:\"\necho \"  ✅ Move card between lists (PUT /cards/:id/move)\"\necho \"  ✅ Reorder cards within list (PUT /cards/:id with position)\"\necho \"  ✅ Position calculations work correctly\"\necho \"  ✅ Database updates persist\"\n",

  "textEditContent": "# API Manual Testing Guide\n\nThis directory contains manual testing scripts for the DriftBoard API endpoints. These scripts use &#96;curl&#96; to test API functionality during development.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. **Backend Server Running**\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cd src/backend\n   npm run dev\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Server should be accessible at &#96;http://localhost:8000&#96;\n\n2. **Database Seeded** (optional but recommended)\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm run seed\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **jq Installed** (for JSON formatting)\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # macOS\n   brew install jq\n   \n   # Ubuntu/Debian\n   apt-get install jq\n   \n   # Windows (WSL)\n   sudo apt-get install jq\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Available Test Scripts\n\n### 1. &#96;lists-crud.sh&#96; - Lists API Testing\nTests all CRUD operations for lists:\n- ✅ Create list in board (&#96;POST /boards/:id/lists&#96;)\n- ✅ Get specific list (&#96;GET /lists/:id&#96;)\n- ✅ Update list name (&#96;PUT /lists/:id&#96;)\n- ✅ Delete list (&#96;DELETE /lists/:id&#96;)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n./lists-crud.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. &#96;cards-crud.sh&#96; - Cards API Testing\nTests all CRUD operations for cards:\n- ✅ Create card in list (&#96;POST /lists/:id/cards&#96;)\n- ✅ Get specific card (&#96;GET /cards/:id&#96;)\n- ✅ Update card title/description (&#96;PUT /cards/:id&#96;)\n- ✅ Delete card (&#96;DELETE /cards/:id&#96;)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n./cards-crud.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. &#96;move-operations.sh&#96; - Drag &amp; Drop Testing\nTests card movement and reordering:\n- ✅ Move card between lists (&#96;PUT /cards/:id/move&#96;)\n- ✅ Reorder cards within list (&#96;PUT /cards/:id&#96;)\n- ✅ Position calculations\n- ✅ Database persistence\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n./move-operations.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. &#96;run-all-tests.sh&#96; - Complete Test Suite\nRuns all tests in sequence with setup validation:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n./run-all-tests.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Expected API Endpoints\n\nBased on the Phase 1 completion plan, these endpoints should be implemented:\n\n### Lists Endpoints\n&#96;&#96;&#96;http\nGET    /api/lists/:id                # Get list with cards\nPUT    /api/lists/:id                # Update list name/position\nDELETE /api/lists/:id                # Delete list\nPOST   /api/boards/:id/lists         # Create list in board\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Cards Endpoints\n&#96;&#96;&#96;http\nGET    /api/cards/:id                # Get card details\nPUT    /api/cards/:id                # Update card\nDELETE /api/cards/:id                # Delete card\nPOST   /api/lists/:id/cards          # Create card in list\nPUT    /api/cards/:id/move           # Move card between lists\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Using the Scripts\n\n### Quick Start\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Make scripts executable\nchmod +x *.sh\n\n# Run all tests\n./run-all-tests.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Individual Testing\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Test just lists\n./lists-crud.sh\n\n# Test just cards\n./cards-crud.sh\n\n# Test move operations\n./move-operations.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Sample Output\n\nEach script provides detailed output showing:\n- 📋 Operation being performed\n- 🔍 Request details\n- ✅ Response validation\n- 📊 Current state verification\n\nExample output:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n=== DriftBoard Lists API Testing ===\n\n🔍 1. Get existing boards to find a board ID...\n✅ Using Board ID: cm123abc456\n\n📋 2. Create a new list...\n✅ Created List ID: cm789def012\n\n📖 3. Get the specific list...\n{\n  \"success\": true,\n  \"data\": {\n    \"id\": \"cm789def012\",\n    \"name\": \"Test List Created by Script\",\n    \"position\": 0,\n    \"cards\": []\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n### Server Not Running\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n❌ Server is not running on http://localhost:8000\n   Please start the server with: cd src/backend &amp;&amp; npm run dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### No Test Data\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n❌ No boards found. import { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { ApiResponse, UpdateListDto, List } from '../../shared/types/index.js';
import { prisma } from '../services/database.js';
import { authMiddleware } from '../middleware/authMiddleware.js';
const router = Router();
// Apply authentication middleware to all routes
router.use(authMiddleware);
/**
 * GET /api/lists/:id
 * Get a specific list with its cards
 */
router.get('/:id', async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;
    if (!id) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'List ID is required',
      });
      return;
    }
    const list = await prisma.list.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: {
        cards: {
          orderBy: { position: 'asc' },
          include: {
            labels: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });
    if (!list) {
      res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'List not found',
      });
      return;
    }
    const response: ApiResponse<List> = {
      success: true,
      data: list,
    };
    res.json(response);
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
});
/**
 * PUT /api/lists/:id
 * Update a list (name, position)
 */
router.put('/:id', async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;
    const updateData: UpdateListDto = req.body;
    if (!id) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'List ID is required',
      });
      return;
    }
    // Validate input
    if (updateData.name !== undefined && (!updateData.name || updateData.name.trim().length === 0)) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'List name cannot be empty',
      });
      return;
    }
    // Check if list exists
    const existingList = await prisma.list.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });
    if (!existingList) {
      res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'List not found',
      });
      return;
    }
    // If position is being updated, handle reordering
    if (updateData.position !== undefined && updateData.position !== existingList.position) {
      // Calculate new positions for reordering
      const oldPosition = existingList.position;
      const newPosition = updateData.position;
      // Update positions of other lists
      if (newPosition < oldPosition) {
        // Moving up - shift lists down
        await prisma.list.updateMany({
          where: {
            boardId: existingList.boardId,
            position: {
              gte: newPosition,
              lt: oldPosition,
            },
          },
          data: {
            position: {
              increment: 1,
            },
          },
        });
      } else {
        // Moving down - shift lists up
        await prisma.list.updateMany({
          where: {
            boardId: existingList.boardId,
            position: {
              gt: oldPosition,
              lte: newPosition,
            },
          },
          data: {
            position: {
              decrement: 1,
            },
          },
        });
      }
    }
    // Update the list
    const updatedList = await prisma.list.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...(updateData.name && { name: updateData.name.trim() }),
        ...(updateData.position !== undefined && { position: updateData.position }),
      },
      include: {
        cards: {
          orderBy: { position: 'asc' },
          include: {
            labels: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });
    const response: ApiResponse<List> = {
      success: true,
      data: updatedList,
      message: 'List updated successfully',
    };
    res.json(response);
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
});
/**
 * DELETE /api/lists/:id
 * Delete a list and all its cards
 */
router.delete('/:id', async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;
    if (!id) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'List ID is required',
      });
      return;
    }
    // Check if list exists
    const existingList = await prisma.list.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });
    if (!existingList) {
      res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'List not found',
      });
      return;
    }
    // Delete the list (cards will be deleted automatically due to cascade)
    await prisma.list.delete({
      where: { id },
    });
    // Reorder remaining lists to fill the gap
    await prisma.list.updateMany({
      where: {
        boardId: existingList.boardId,
        position: {
          gt: existingList.position,
        },
      },
      data: {
        position: {
          decrement: 1,
        },
      },
    });
    const response: ApiResponse = {
      success: true,
      message: 'List deleted successfully',
    };
    res.json(response);
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
});
/**
 * POST /api/lists/:id/cards

 * Create a new card in a list

 */

router.post('/:id/cards', async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {

  try {

    const { id: listId } = req.params;

    const { title, description, position }: { title: string; description?: string; position?: number } = req.body;



    if (!listId) {

      res.status(400).json({

        success: false,

        error: 'List ID is required',

      });

      return;

    }



    if (!title || title.trim().length === 0) {

      res.status(400).json({

        success: false,

        error: 'Card title is required',

      });

      return;

    }



    // Check if list exists

    const list = await prisma.list.findUnique({

      where: { id: listId },

    });



    if (!list) {

      res.status(404).json({

        success: false,

        error: 'List not found',

      });

      return;

    }



    // Calculate position if not provided

    let cardPosition = position;

    if (cardPosition === undefined) {

      const maxPosition = await prisma.card.aggregate({

        where: { listId },

        _max: { position: true },

      });

      cardPosition = (maxPosition._max?.position ?? -1) + 1;

    } else {

      // If position is specified, shift existing cards

      await prisma.card.updateMany({

        where: {

          listId,

          position: {

            gte: cardPosition,

          },

        },

        data: {

          position: {

            increment: 1,

          },

        },

      });

    }



    const card = await prisma.card.create({

      data: {

        title: title.trim(),

        description: description?.trim() || null,

        listId,

        position: cardPosition,

      },

      include: {

        labels: true,

      },

    });



    const response: ApiResponse = {

      success: true,

      data: card,

      message: 'Card created successfully',

    };



    res.status(201).json(response);

  } catch (error) {

    next(error);

  }

});



export { router as listsRouter };

  "textEditContent": "/**\n * Position calculation utilities for kanban board elements\n */\n\n/**\n * Calculate position for inserting an item between two positions\n * @param before - Position of item before (or undefined if at start)\n * @param after - Position of item after (or undefined if at end)\n * @returns New position value\n */\nexport function calculatePositionBetween(before?: number, after?: number): number {\n  if (!before &amp;&amp; !after) {\n    return 1000; // First item\n  }\n  \n  if (!before) {\n    return after! / 2; // Insert at beginning\n  }\n  \n  if (!after) {\n    return before + 1000; // Insert at end\n  }\n  \n  return (before + after) / 2; // Insert between\n}\n\n/**\n * Calculate the next available position after all existing items\n * @param maxPosition - The highest existing position (or undefined if no items)\n * @returns New position value\n */\nexport function calculateNextPosition(maxPosition?: number): number {\n  return (maxPosition || 0) + 1000;\n}\n\n/**\n * Validate that a position value is valid (positive number)\n * @param position - Position to validate\n * @returns true if valid, false otherwise\n */\nexport function isValidPosition(position: number): boolean {\n  return typeof position === 'number' &amp;&amp; position &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; !isNaN(position);\n}\n\n/**\n * Normalize positions to prevent precision issues with decimal positions\n * @param items - Array of items with position property\n * @returns Array of items with normalized positions (starting from 1000, incrementing by 1000)\n */\nexport function normalizePositions&lt;T extends { position: number }&gt;(items: T[]): T[] {\n  const sorted = [...items].sort((a, b) =&gt; a.position - b.position);\n  \n  return sorted.map((item, index) =&gt; ({\n    ...item,\n    position: 1000 + (index * 1000)\n  }));\n}\n\n/**\n * Check if positions need normalization (when they get too close or have precision issues)\n * @param positions - Array of position values\n * @returns true if normalization is recommended\n */\nexport function shouldNormalizePositions(positions: number[]): boolean {\n  const sorted = [...positions].sort((a, b) =&gt; a - b);\n  \n  for (let i = 1; i &lt; sorted.length; i++) {\n    const diff = sorted[i] - sorted[i - 1];\n    if (diff &lt; 1) {\n      return true; // Positions too close\n    }\n  }\n  \n  return false;\n}\n\n/**\n * Reorder operation types for position updates\n */\nexport interface ReorderOperation {\n  type: 'move_up' | 'move_down';\n  oldPosition: number;\n  newPosition: number;\n  boardId?: string;\n  listId?: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Calculate which items need position updates during a reorder operation\n * @param operation - The reorder operation details\n * @returns Object with items to increment and decrement\n */\nexport function calculateReorderUpdates(operation: ReorderOperation): {\n  increment: { min: number; max: number } | null;\n  decrement: { min: number; max: number } | null;\n} {\n  const { oldPosition, newPosition } = operation;\n  \n  if (newPosition &lt; oldPosition) {\n    // Moving up - increment positions of items between new and old position\n    return {\n      increment: { min: newPosition, max: oldPosition - 1 },\n      decrement: null\n    };\n  } else if (newPosition &gt; oldPosition) {\n    // Moving down - decrement positions of items between old and new position\n    return {\n      increment: null,\n      decrement: { min: oldPosition + 1, max: newPosition }\n    };\n  }\n  \n  // No position change\n  return { increment: null, decrement: null };\n}\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

(string): Card ID\n\n**Request Body:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"listId\": \"list_target\",\n  \"position\": 500\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Response:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": true,\n  \"data\": {\n    \"id\": \"card_789\",\n    \"title\": \"Task 1\",\n    \"description\": \"Description of task 1\",\n    \"position\": 500,\n    \"listId\": \"list_target\",\n    \"dueDate\": null,\n    \"createdAt\": \"2025-07-09T10:00:00.000Z\",\n    \"updatedAt\": \"2025-07-09T10:00:00.000Z\",\n    \"labels\": [],\n    \"activities\": []\n  },\n  \"message\": \"Card moved successfully\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### DELETE /cards/:id\n\nDelete a card.\n\n**Parameters:**\n- &#96;id&#96; (string): Card ID\n\n**Response:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": true,\n  \"message\": \"Card deleted successfully\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Error Responses\n\n### 400 Bad Request\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": false,\n  \"error\": \"Validation error message\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 404 Not Found\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": false,\n  \"error\": \"Resource not found\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 500 Internal Server Error\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": false,\n  \"error\": \"Internal server error\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Position Management\n\nDriftBoard uses a position-based ordering system for lists and cards:\n\n- Positions are positive numbers (typically starting from 0)\n- New items get position = max(existing_positions) + 1000\n- When items are reordered, other items' positions are automatically adjusted\n- Moving items between lists handles position gaps automatically\n- The system supports decimal positions for fine-grained ordering\n\n## Rate Limiting\n\nCurrently no rate limiting is implemented. In production, consider implementing rate limiting for security and performance.\n\n## Data Validation\n\nAll endpoints validate input data:\n- Required fields are enforced\n- String fields are trimmed\n- Empty strings for required fields are rejected\n- Invalid UUIDs are rejected\n- Foreign key constraints are enforced (board/list/card relationships)\n",

  "textEditContent": "# Manual Testing Guide\n\nThis guide provides instructions for manually testing the DriftBoard API endpoints using curl scripts and other manual testing procedures.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n- DriftBoard backend server running on &#96;http://localhost:8000&#96;\n- &#96;curl&#96; command-line tool installed\n- &#96;jq&#96; (optional, for pretty-printing JSON responses)\n\n## Quick Start\n\n1. Run all manual tests:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cd tests/manual/api\n   ./run-all-tests.sh\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Manual Test Scripts\n\nAll manual test scripts are located in &#96;tests/manual/api/&#96; directory:\n\n### Available Scripts\n\n1. **&#96;lists-crud.sh&#96;** - Tests all list operations (CRUD + position management)\n2. **&#96;cards-crud.sh&#96;** - Tests all card operations (CRUD + updates)  \n3. **&#96;move-operations.sh&#96;** - Tests card move operations between lists\n4. **&#96;run-all-tests.sh&#96;** - Runs all test scripts in sequence\n\n### Running Individual Tests\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Test lists functionality\n./tests/manual/api/lists-crud.sh\n\n# Test cards functionality  \n./tests/manual/api/cards-crud.sh\n\n# Test move operations\n./tests/manual/api/move-operations.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Test Scenarios Covered\n\n### Health Check\n- ✅ API health status endpoint\n- ✅ Server uptime and version info\n\n### Boards API\n- ✅ Get all boards\n- ✅ Get specific board with lists and cards\n- ✅ Create new board\n- ✅ Update board details\n- ✅ Delete board\n- ✅ Create list in board\n\n### Lists API\n- ✅ Get list with cards\n- ✅ Update list name and position\n- ✅ Delete list (cascades to cards)\n- ✅ Position reordering logic\n- ✅ Error handling for invalid requests\n\n### Cards API\n- ✅ Create card in list\n- ✅ Get card details\n- ✅ Update card title, description, position\n- ✅ Delete card\n- ✅ Position management within list\n\n### Move Operations\n- ✅ Move card to different list\n- ✅ Reorder card within same list\n- ✅ Position calculation and gap filling\n- ✅ Error handling for invalid moves\n\n## Manual Testing Procedure\n\n### 1. Health Check\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncurl -X GET http://localhost:8000/api/health | jq\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nExpected: &#96;200 OK&#96; with status \"healthy\"\n\n### 2. Board Operations\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Get all boards\ncurl -X GET http://localhost:8000/api/boards | jq\n\n# Create a test board\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/boards \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"name\":\"Test Board\",\"description\":\"Manual testing board\"}' | jq\n\n# Get board with ID (replace BOARD_ID)\ncurl -X GET http://localhost:8000/api/boards/BOARD_ID | jq\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. List Operations\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Create a list in board (replace BOARD_ID)\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/boards/BOARD_ID/lists \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"name\":\"Test List\",\"position\":0}' | jq\n\n# Get list details (replace LIST_ID)\ncurl -X GET http://localhost:8000/api/lists/LIST_ID | jq\n\n# Update list\ncurl -X PUT http://localhost:8000/api/lists/LIST_ID \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"name\":\"Updated List\",\"position\":1000}' | jq\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. Card Operations\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Create card in list (replace LIST_ID)\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/lists/LIST_ID/cards \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"title\":\"Test Card\",\"description\":\"Manual test card\",\"position\":0}' | jq\n\n# Get card details (replace CARD_ID)\ncurl -X GET http://localhost:8000/api/cards/CARD_ID | jq\n\n# Update card\ncurl -X PUT http://localhost:8000/api/cards/CARD_ID \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"title\":\"Updated Card\",\"description\":\"Updated description\"}' | jq\n\n# Move card to different list (replace LIST_TARGET_ID)\ncurl -X PUT http://localhost:8000/api/cards/CARD_ID/move \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"listId\":\"LIST_TARGET_ID\",\"position\":500}' | jq\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 5. Error Testing\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Test with invalid board ID\ncurl -X GET http://localhost:8000/api/boards/invalid-id | jq\n\n# Test with empty required fields\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/boards \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"name\":\"\",\"description\":\"Empty name test\"}' | jq\n\n# Test moving card to non-existent list\ncurl -X PUT http://localhost:8000/api/cards/CARD_ID/move \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"listId\":\"non-existent-id\",\"position\":0}' | jq\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Automated Test Scripts Details\n\n### lists-crud.sh\n\nTests the complete lifecycle of list management:\n\n1. **Setup**: Gets a board ID for testing\n2. **Create**: Creates a new list with position 0\n3. **Read**: Retrieves the created list\n4. **Update**: Updates list name and position\n5. **Create Second**: Creates another list for position testing\n6. **Position Test**: Updates first list position to test reordering\n7. **Delete**: Removes both test lists\n8. **Cleanup**: Verifies lists are deleted\n\n### cards-crud.sh\n\nTests the complete lifecycle of card management:\n\n1. **Setup**: Gets board and list IDs for testing\n2. **Create**: Creates a new card with title and description\n3. **Read**: Retrieves the created card\n4. **Update Title**: Updates card title\n5. **Update Description**: Updates card description\n6. **Update Position**: Changes card position\n7. **Delete**: Removes the test card\n8. **Cleanup**: Verifies card is deleted\n\n### move-operations.sh\n\nTests card movement scenarios:\n\n1. **Setup**: Creates board, lists, and cards for testing\n2. **Same List Move**: Moves card to different position in same list\n3. **Different List Move**: Moves card to different list\n4. **Position Verification**: Checks that positions are updated correctly\n5. **Error Testing**: Tests invalid move scenarios\n6. **Cleanup**: Removes all test data\n\n## Expected Results\n\n### Successful Operations\n- HTTP status codes: 200 (GET, PUT, DELETE) or 201 (POST)\n- Response format: &#96;{\"success\": true, \"data\": {...}, \"message\": \"...\"}&#96;\n- Data integrity: IDs, timestamps, relationships preserved\n\n### Error Cases\n- HTTP status codes: 400 (validation), 404 (not found), 500 (server error)\n- Response format: &#96;{\"success\": false, \"error\": \"error message\"}&#96;\n- Appropriate error messages for each failure type\n\n### Position Management\n- New items get auto-assigned positions (typically increments of 1000)\n- Reordering updates other items' positions automatically\n- No duplicate positions in same container (list/board)\n- Gaps in positions are filled when items are moved/deleted\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n### Common Issues\n\n1. **Server not running**\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Check if server is running\n   curl -f http://localhost:8000/api/health || echo \"Server not responding\"\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Database locked**\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Restart the backend server\n   npm run dev:backend\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Invalid JSON in response**\n   - Check server logs for errors\n   - Ensure Content-Type header is set for POST/PUT requests\n\n4. **Permission errors**\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Make scripts executable\n   chmod +x tests/manual/api/*.sh\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Debugging Tips\n\n1. **Add verbose output to curl**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   curl -v -X GET http://localhost:8000/api/health\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Save responses for inspection**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   curl -X GET http://localhost:8000/api/boards &gt; boards_response.json\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Check server logs**:\n   - Look at terminal where &#96;npm run dev:backend&#96; is running\n   - Check for error messages and stack traces\n\n4. **Validate JSON syntax**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   echo '{\"name\":\"test\"}' | jq '.' # Should pretty-print if valid\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Integration with Automated Tests\n\nThe manual tests complement the automated integration tests:\n\n- **Manual tests**: Good for exploratory testing, debugging, and verification\n- **Integration tests**: Good for regression testing and CI/CD\n- **Both**: Cover the same API endpoints but with different approaches\n\nRun both types of tests to ensure comprehensive coverage:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Run manual tests\n./tests/manual/api/run-all-tests.sh\n\n# Run automated integration tests  \nnpm run test:integration\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Next Steps\n\nAfter manual testing is complete, consider:\n\n1. **Frontend Integration**: Test API endpoints from the React frontend\n2. **Performance Testing**: Test with larger datasets and concurrent requests\n3. **Security Testing**: Test authentication, authorization, and input validation\n4. **Documentation Updates**: Keep this guide updated as API evolves\n",
